Consistently logged into the application (shouldn’t have to login all the time)

Application performance / utilization issues

Uneven performance. When it works, this app is great. You can see what classes are available and who’s teaching them, you can set up favorites for different studios or cities, you can register for classes in advance and have them added to your calendar, and you can track how many classes you’ve been to.

Sadly, the app’s performance has been incredibly inconsistent over time. There are times where I have to repeatedly open and close the app to get the different schedules to come up, the search function is awkward, it no longer seems to add classes to my calendar, and the class tracking is often inaccurate.

As someone who goes to CPY 3-4 times a week and travels frequently, I find the app frustrating to use and out of alignment with what is a pretty consistent in-person experience of nice studios, great amenities, passionate teachers, and vigorous flow experience. I would love to see this app fixed so it can perform its basic functions well and reliably.

COREPOWER: Do yourself a favor, and just hire a UX research consultancy next time. You’ll save money in the long run by avoiding stupid mistakes that infuriate and annoy your customers.

CANNOT USE.... I tried logging in. And it won’t register my email! I try to reset password and it won’t send!! I just want to look at the class schedules to see if I even want a membership vs going online and looking it up. Why would I want a membership if I can’t access the classes easier? Someone get a new team of engineers to fix the app. Please.

Downward facing app. It’s shivasana time. That’s a yoga joke for this app should be done. Doesn’t auto recognize the time of day so if you’re looking at 10pm at night it won’t take you to the next day, doesn’t proceed to next page after picking type of class, asks you to save the filter - a worthless feature that slows down the process. Old app was way better. Namaste.
App doesn’t work. Doesn’t work at all

Yikes. Yikes. There is far too much money circulating through this company to make such a terrible app. It shuts down on me every time I try to sign up. And I have to sign up because it can’t locate my file as the longtime member I am. This leaves me to use the website to check schedules, which on my phone is very cumbersome. I am so disappointed! I had issues months ago, checked back, and there are still issues. Please, something needs to change!

Why make the change?. I used the old app to compare options of schedules for studios close to me. I’m ready to get back on the mat and I can’t figure this out. I can’t get past the address screen. First error 500. Then a white screen and it crashes. Why do you need an email and address so I can see when classes are. Please don’t make it harder for me to give you money.
App doesn’t even work. Can’t even create an account without the app crashing. Just trying to check the schedules...terrible.

Couldn’t sign in with old name or create new. Horrible. I’ve just wasted 30 minutes of my time messing with this app. Can’t login, and when I register, it shuts down right before I can finish. Absolutely worthless. Sadly, I just wasted more of my time writing this review. Won’t be visiting core power yoga anytime soon. Very frustrating.
